# `⌿` — Replicate / Reduce first

`N⌿Y` replicates first-axis cells.

```apl
1 0⌿2 3⍴⍳6         ⍝ 1 3⍴1 2 3
```

`f⌿Y` reduces the first axis.

```apl
+⌿2 3⍴⍳6           ⍝ 5 7 9
```

`S f⌿Y` starts each lane from the whole seed `S` on the right.

```apl
10+⌿3 2⍴⍳6         ⍝ 19 22
```

Counts, identities and `⍤[K]` follow [`/`](slash.qmd).
